props.name: children
props.description: The interface to warp. Ordinary markup — it stays interactive.

props.name: bodies
props.description: What gets pulled. Every element matching this inside the field is a body; everything else rides with its parent. The default takes the children of the field, which is usually a grid of cards.

props.name: horizon
props.description: Radius of the event horizon in pixels. Inside it, a body is gone.

props.name: reach
props.description: How far the pull is felt, in pixels.

props.name: strength
props.description: Overall strength, 1 being the tuned default.

props.name: spin
props.description: Degrees a body is turned at full pull, as the hole's spin drags it round.

props.name: origin
props.description: Where the hole starts, as a fraction of the field: `[0.5, 0.5]` is the middle.

props.name: followPointer
props.description: Follow the pointer over the field rather than waiting to be dragged.

props.name: tone
props.description: The disc's colour: the page's ink, or the accent.

props.name: paused
props.description: Stop the spin and hold everything where it is.

props.name: label
props.defaultValue: 'A singularity warping the interface around it'
props.description: Accessible name for the hole, which is a figure in its own right.
